title: Redwood November 2026 All-Hands
summary: Quarterly all-hands covering Q4 goals, hiring, product roadmap for Runtime 2.0, security/compliance updates, and customer highlights. Leadership reviewed metrics and outlined next steps for OKRs and hiring cadence.
action_items: Asha Patel: finalize Q4 hiring plan by 2026-12-05
Liam Chen: publish performance benchmark deck for Runtime 2.0 by 2026-11-28
Priya Nair: share SOC2 roadmap and gaps with Legal by 2026-11-30
Evan Brooks: consolidate customer case study notes and send to Marketing by 2026-11-27
next_steps: Leadership to share OKR doc with company tomorrow
All teams to submit milestone status in Monday sync
Schedule product deep-dive with sales next week (Liam + Jordan)
Security to publish audit readiness checklist
transcript:
Meeting header - 2026-11-21 16:00 UTC | Duration 60m
Attendees: Asha, Liam, Jordan, Sofia, Maya, Evan, Priya, Samir, Riley, Taylor + company-wide

00:00 Asha Patel: hey everyone, thanks for joining, um, happy to see so many faces, quick housekeeping, recording's on, slides are in the #all-hands channel. we'll kick off with high-level numbers.
00:28 Asha Patel: Q4 we're focused on three things, one hire velocity, two runtime 2.0 stability, three sales-led expansion. quick show of hands, can everyone see the deck? // brief chuckle //
01:05 Liam Chen: yes, hi folks, on the runtime side, we've made progress on kernel selection and batching improvements, uh, latency p50 improved by roughly 12% in internal benchmarks, still work to do on tail latency.
01:40 Jordan Rivera: product notes, we plan a staged rollout: canary to Dedicated customers first, then Hosted API, and private deploys follow. target is end of Q1 for full GA but we'll iterate.
02:12 Sofia Morales: engineering update, hiring's been good, we've onboarded two infra SREs last month, but we need more ML infra engineers to hit our throughput goals.
02:45 Maya Singh: sales update, pipeline healthy, we closed two mid-market deals referencing the performance improvements, customers asking specifically about VPC and KMS support.
03:10 Evan Brooks: CS highlight, customer X reported a 25% cost reduction after switching caching profiles, exact numbers in the shared doc, link in chat.
03:40 Priya Nair: security quick, SOC2 renewal on track, we have a few control gaps to address around key rotation and audit logging retention policies, will share details after post-meeting.
04:05 Asha Patel: ok let's dig into metrics — Riley?
04:30 Riley Park: reliability numbers, uptime 99.95% last 30 days, incident count down vs previous quarter, mean time to recover 18 minutes average, but two outliers we investigated.
05:05 Asha Patel: can you summarize those outliers, Riley?
05:20 Riley Park: yeah, one was a mis-config in autoscaler, second was a third-party driver update that regressed a kernel path, we rolled back and hotfixed.
05:50 Liam Chen: on the kernel regression, we're adding more integration tests to catch that earlier, also a plan to instrument a micro-benchmark suite per variant.
06:25 Jordan Rivera: product roadmap slide, highlights: model catalog improvements, structured output tooling, function/tool calling UX, and runtime 2.0 GA timeline.
06:58 Samir Desai: a note on prioritization — we're leaning to prioritize stability and predictable latency before adding more features to the Hosted API.
07:20 Asha Patel: good call. hiring plan — Samir, Jordan want to coordinate with Eng to finalize roles.
07:40 Jordan Rivera: yep, we'll sync with Sofia offline.
08:00 Maya Singh: sales asks for a security packet we can share with customers — SSO/SAML, RBAC, KMS details — Priya can you provide that?
08:18 Priya Nair: yes, we'll publish a customer-facing security brief and a deeper technical annex for deals.
08:40 Evan Brooks: customer wins — highlight one enterprise that moved to Dedicated due to SLA needs, they cited predictable throughput as the main reason.
09:05 Asha Patel: moving on to OKRs, Marketing and Product to align on messaging for performance storylines, Taylor?
09:25 Taylor Nguyen: marketing will draft a one-pager and a benchmark blog, need performance decks from Liam by next week to source numbers.
09:48 Liam Chen: will do, pushing the benchmark deck by 2026-11-28, note there are still a couple of measurement caveats.
10:10 Asha Patel: finance update quick — burn plan unchanged; runway extended slightly after recent revenue upticks, finance will post details.
10:35 Samir Desai: question from ladder: any change on Dedicated pricing with runtime 2.0?
10:55 Maya Singh: pricing TBD, sales prefers to keep existing committed tiers, maybe a premium for early access GA, we'll coordinate with finance.
11:20 Priya Nair: compliance note — data residency requests increasing from EU customers, need clear guidance for Private deployments and KMS locations.
11:50 Asha Patel: noted. Operations — Sofia?
12:05 Sofia Morales: autoscaling improvements are in staging, will reduce cold-start tail latency, we have a rollout window this month for a subset of pods.
12:40 Riley Park: also more fine-grained tracing to correlate request patterns with KV cache hits, should help optimize batching heuristics.
13:05 Evan Brooks: CS asks for a simple guide on recommended cache profiles per workload type, will compile and share.
13:30 Asha Patel: community and open-source work — shares on reference apps continue, please contribute to the eval harness repo.
13:55 Jordan Rivera: quick demo teaser of structured output tool — will schedule separate session for product folks and sales.
14:20 Audience: (several folks) applause and quick questions in chat.
14:50 Asha Patel: we have a few live Qs — first, what's the plan if the canary fails during Dedicated rollout? Liam?
15:10 Liam Chen: automatic rollback policy and fallback to previous model variant, plus a manual kill-switch through Console, and we will notify affected routes.
15:40 Priya Nair: security will add guardrails to the rollout playbook and require an approvals check for private deployments.
16:05 Asha Patel: second Q, any change to data retention for Hosted API? Priya?
16:25 Priya Nair: no immediate change, but we're proposing shorter retention defaults for compliance-sensitive customers and an option for opt-in analytics.
16:55 Maya Singh: sales asks for a checklist for private deployment pre-sales — include network, KMS, compliance, and audit logs, file in the sales repo.
17:20 Evan Brooks: also, CS to run a health-check playbook 1:1 with top 10 enterprise customers.
17:45 Asha Patel: hiring cadence — we need to speed interviews for ML infra roles, Sofia to coordinate with Talent.
18:05 Sofia Morales: will set up interview blitz next week.
18:30 Jordan Rivera: roadmap question — will we support more quantized model variants out-of-box? Liam: yes, but testing required.
18:58 Liam Chen: plan to add quantization profiles to model catalog with recommended workloads.
19:20 Asha Patel: final wrap — recap of action items, please check Slack for links and timelines.
19:40 Asha Patel: thanks everyone, meeting adjourned.

Post-meeting notes: links posted to #all-hands: Q4-OKRs doc, Runtime2.0-canary playbook, SOC2-gap-list, hiring tracker.
notes: Slides + benchmark deck links referenced in chat; security packet to be posted. transcript has occasional ASR errors (proper nouns sometimes garbled).
